children: Conduent reached an agreement in principle in August 2026 to settle consolidated lawsuits arising from its January 2025 cybersecurity incident.
Agreement in principle reached to settle consolidated New Jersey federal litigation over the January 2025 data breach.
Settlement disclosed in a joint status report filed September 10, 2026; paperwork not finalized and court approval pending.
Company denies plaintiffs' allegations, believes it has strong defenses, and sought settlement to avoid litigation costs and burdens.
Maintains cyber insurance and does not expect the settlement to have a material impact on financial position, results or cash flows.
